threat_event: Attackers disable or falsify lighting alarms through legacy RMUs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,100 legacy RMUs on public IP addresses with shared credentials
existing_controls: Alarm center watches for missing heartbeats
treatment_plan: Move legacy RMUs to the private APN or replace them; device certificates

threat_event: Lighting alarms are lost when the shared service assurance platform is down or isolated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written fallback to daily observation; alarm tenant depends on the Carrier platform
existing_controls: Vendor direct alerting for about 5,100 newer units
treatment_plan: Written fallback procedure; standby ingestion route; include in failover test

threat_event: Cellular backhaul outage cuts off the legacy RMU fleet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single cellular provider for legacy RMUs

threat_event: Hurricane damages lighting on many structures at once
affected_asset_or_process: Towers in Florida and the Gulf states
treatment_plan: Pre-storm FAA contact plan; joint storm plan (GR-11)

threat_event: FAA reports or outage records are missed during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records in spreadsheets; FAA steps not in the group IR plan
treatment_plan: Records in SYS-T2; P08 matrix row
